commands.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p dist/pkg
cp "target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/nac-web" dist/pkg/nac-web
cp LICENSE dist/pkg/LICENSE
tar -czf "dist/nac-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz" \
  -C dist/pkg nac-web LICENSE

short_revision="$(git rev-parse --short=12 "$SOURCE_SHA")"
test "$(dist/pkg/nac-web -V)" = "nac-web $RELEASE_VERSION"
test "$(dist/pkg/nac-web --version)" = "nac-web $RELEASE_VERSION ($short_revision)"
